earlier_scan.note: Glottolog: entry retired for bookkeeping; ISO 639-3 retired 2016 as non-existent — spurious language, no documentation exists

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority. 2015. Change Request Number 2015-033: retire [toe] Tomedes (submitted by Editor, Ethnologue, 2015-05-28; adopted, effective 2016-01-15). SIL International. 5 pp.
sources.note: Nothing; the document retires the code because 'There is no evidence that the language exists' (p.2 sec.3): Wares to Grimes 1971 said Tomedes should be deleted as non-existent; absent from Adelaar 2004, Campbell 1997, Dixon & Aikhenvald 1999, Loukotka 1968, Crevels 2007, Voegelin & Voegelin 1977; Hammarstrom 2015 cites Landaburu 2000 and Ortiz 1965 for non-attestation.

sources.citation: Hammarström, Forkel, Haspelmath & Bank (eds.), Glottolog 5.3, languoid page tome1239 'Bookkeeping: Tomedes'.
sources.note: Nothing; page states the entry 'has been retired and is featured here only for bookkeeping purposes', ISO retirement reason 'non-existent', effective 2016-01-15; zero descriptive references.
